decisive_items: Biopsy of posterior left pleural thickening showed CD5+, CD10−, non-germinal center B-cell type
Avid irregular enhancement within the right cavernous sinus and enlargement of the right side compared with the left
Air fluid levels in bilateral sphenoid and maxillary sinuses
response.rationale: The biopsy results specifically indicating CD5+, CD10−, non-germinal center B-cell type point towards Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, while the imaging findings could support either Sarcoidosis or Tolosa-Hunt syndrome, but the direct pathological evidence tips the scale towards lymphoma.

rejected.why: Lack of systemic evidence beyond localized cavernous sinus involvement
